notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
A new game mode "Meat Grinder" has been added, as well as a new vehicle - the M1A2C tank.
Bugs and errors were also fixed. The vehicle now has team markings instead of widgets.
Hope you like the update)

Download the game:
Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MemoryShards.BFBMS
